dateline: Seoul, South Korea — BTS FESTA 2026 begins June 1 (13th anniversary countdown underway); Nike By You × BTS ARIRANG live in 20+ cities; BTS × Oreo hotteok presale open globally; ARMY presale for Asia & Australia legs opens June 2; Busan Asiad Main Stadium anniversary shows June 12–13
heroHeadline: Day 4,736: BTS FESTA 2026 Launches — Nike By You & Oreo Hotteok Go Live; Eyes on Busan Anniversary Shows June 12–13
heroSubtitle: June 1, 2026 is Day 4,736 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS FESTA 2026 officially begins today — the 13-day anniversary countdown to the group's 13th debut date, the first FESTA conducted during an active world tour. Big Hit Music revealed the FESTA schedule on Weverse at midnight KST (Soompi, allkpop), including a family photo drop (June 4), the 'Hooligan' official performance video (June 5) timed to the opening of 'BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Busan,' and a Weverse Live session on the eve of the anniversary. The Nike By You × BTS ARIRANG customization experience went live globally in 20+ cities today, with in-store queues exceeding 5 hours in Seoul and Busan; BTS × Oreo limited-edition hotteok-flavored cookie presale also opened at OREO.com/UnwrapTheCollab. BTS members are in transit from Las Vegas to South Korea following their historic four-night Allegiant Stadium residency (~260,000 fans, May 23–28) and the 52nd American Music Awards (May 25: Artist of the Year, Song of the Summer, Best Male K-Pop — 14 total AMA wins, all-time record). On the charts, 'SWIM' holds No. 1 on Billboard Global (Excl. US) for a 7th time in 2026 (3 consecutive weeks) and No. 55 on the Hot 100 in its 10th consecutive charting week — an all-time K-pop record. The ARMY membership presale for the Asia and Australia legs of the ARIRANG World Tour (November 2026–March 2027, Kaohsiung through Manila) opens June 2. 'BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Busan' citywide experience opens June 5. Anniversary concerts at Busan Asiad Main Stadium on June 12–13 will be streamed globally via Trafalgar Releasing cinema live viewing on June 13.
